newsitem.title: JAPAN: NCB sinks further on restructuring doubts.
newsitem.headline: NCB sinks further on restructuring doubts.

text.p: Nippon Credit Bank Ltd's shares continued to fall on Thursday morning, dragged down by uncertainty over the effectiveness of its restructuring plan, brokers said.

By 0054 GMT, the shares had sunk 22 yen or 9.87 percent to 201 yen. The bank was the largest percentage loser on the first section of the Tokyo bourse and the most heavily traded issue at 4.746 million shares.
"The negative sentiment is being carried over from the Wednesday session," a broker at a medium-sized brokerage said.
"The market believes that the bank's market value is lower than at present, despite the restructuring plans, and the share price is continuing to slip."
